mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates a shift toward monetary easing, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of future equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% in a single month signals tightening monetary policy, raising discount rates and reducing the present value of future equity cash flows, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 100,000 jobs for 3 consecutive months indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 50,000 jobs for 3 consecutive months signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer and business confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in retail sales (GDPC1) above 1% for 3 consecutive months indicates growing consumer demand, which raises corporate earnings expectations and compresses discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in rising demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for 3 consecutive months indicates contracting supply capacity, which raises production costs and compresses margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL inflation index over 3 consecutive months below 2% indicates disinflation, lowering the real discount rate and increasing the present value of future equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in disinflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4% for 3 consecutive months indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer and business confidence and corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
